title: Checkpoint and reap Engram sessions before project deletion
outcome: delete_project currently detaches/removes the project without the off-lock Engram reset fence used by settings changes, so begun grants and control sidecars can be orphaned.
acceptance: Deleting an Engram-enabled project fences new adapter work, checkpoints begun grants with exit off-lock, reaps all affected sidecars, preserves persistence rollback semantics, and has race coverage.
